builder.deleteBody: Past workouts from it stay in your history.
builder.discardBody: Your edits to this split haven't been saved.
builder.name: Split name
builder.notesHint: Notes are suggestions. You can save any split.
builder.nothingToFlag: Nothing to flag. Each tracked muscle gets about two sessions a week.
builder.removeDayBody: Its {exercises} will be removed from the split.
builder.useAsPlan: Use as my plan after saving
common.storageError: Couldn't save: browser storage is full or blocked.
community.c-arnold6.blurb: Six days, each pairing done twice a week.
community.c-arnold6.name: Chest-Back / Shoulders-Arms / Legs
community.c-bro5.blurb: One body part a day, five days a week.
community.c-bro5.name: Classic Bro Split
community.c-fb3.blurb: Three short full-body days. Big lifts only.
community.c-fb3.name: Minimal Full Body
community.c-home3.blurb: Dumbbells and a bench, three days a week.
community.c-home3.name: Home Dumbbell 3-Day
community.c-ul4.blurb: Four days, a heavier and a lighter version of each.
community.c-ul4.name: Heavy / Light Upper Lower
custom.deleteBody: It leaves your library and pickers. Logged sets keep counting, and splits that use it still show it.
custom.err.duplicate: An exercise with this name already exists
custom.err.name: Give it a name
custom.err.primary: Pick at least one primary muscle, so sets can count for it
custom.intro: Custom exercises get the same prescription and hard-set counting as built-in ones.
custom.name: Name
custom.tip.compoundNoHelpers: Compound lifts usually have helper muscles. Adding them lets the week count them at ½.
custom.tip.footer: Suggestions only. Save whenever you're ready.
custom.tip.isolationMany: Isolation exercises usually train one muscle. If this one trains several, Compound may fit better.
custom.tip.tooManyPrimary: Most exercises load one to three muscles hard. Listing fewer primaries keeps your weekly counts honest; the rest can go under secondary.
custom.typeHint: Sets the rep range: compound {compound}, isolation {isolation}.
exercise.ab-wheel-rollout.name: Ab Wheel Rollout (kneeling)
exercise.ab-wheel-rollout.position: Arms reaching far forward with the body extended: abs are at their longest and the lever is longest here.
exercise.access.barOrTable: needs a bar or sturdy table
exercise.access.unloaded: can be done unloaded (rear foot on a chair)
exercise.assisted-pull-up-machine.name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
exercise.assisted-pull-up-machine.positi: Arms overhead at the bottom: lats are at their longest.
exercise.back-extension-45.name: 45° Back Extension (hip hinge)
exercise.back-extension-45.position: Torso lowered toward the floor with hips bent: glutes and hamstrings are at their longest.
exercise.barbell-back-squat.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercise.barbell-back-squat.position: Bottom of a deep squat with hips and knees fully bent: quads and glutes are at their longest (the rectus femoris part of the quads is not, because the hip is bent).
exercise.barbell-bench-press.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercise.barbell-bench-press.position: Bottom of the press, hands or bar near chest level with elbows behind the torso: chest is at its longest.
exercise.barbell-bent-over-row.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercise.barbell-bent-over-row.position: Arms hanging straight down at the bottom: upper back and lats are at their longest.
exercise.barbell-curl.name: Standing Barbell Curl
exercise.barbell-curl.position: Arms straight by the sides at the bottom: biceps are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.barbell-hip-thrust.name: Barbell Hip Thrust (upper back on bench)
exercise.barbell-hip-thrust.position: Hips lowered toward the floor: glutes are at their longest in this movement; it is hardest at the top with the hips fully extended.
exercise.barbell-overhead-press.name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
exercise.barbell-overhead-press.position: Bar at the upper chest/collarbone: front delts are at their longest in this movement; it is hardest around the lower-middle part of the press.
exercise.barbell-rollout.name: Barbell Rollout (kneeling, plates on the bar)
exercise.barbell-rollout.position: Arms reaching far forward with the body extended: abs are at their longest and the lever is longest here.
exercise.barbell-romanian-deadlift.cue.3: Stop when hips stop moving back
exercise.barbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercise.barbell-romanian-deadlift.posit: Bottom of the hinge with hips pushed back and knees soft: hamstrings and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.barbell-shrug.name: Barbell Shrug
exercise.barbell-shrug.position: Shoulders relaxed and pulled down by the bar: upper traps are at their longest.
exercise.barbell-split-squat.name: Barbell Split Squat
exercise.barbell-split-squat.position: Bottom of the lunge: front-leg quads and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.barbell-wrist-curl.name: Barbell Wrist Curl (forearms on bench)
exercise.barbell-wrist-curl.position: Wrists bent back at the bottom: wrist flexors are at their longest.
exercise.bayesian-cable-curl.name: Bayesian Cable Curl (facing away, pulley low behind)
exercise.bayesian-cable-curl.position: Arm straight and pulled behind the body by the cable: biceps are stretched with the shoulder extended, and the cable is hardest near this position.
exercise.belt-squat.name: Belt Squat Machine
exercise.belt-squat.position: Bottom of a deep squat with hips and knees fully bent: quads and glutes are at their longest (the rectus femoris part of the quads is not, because the hip is bent).
exercise.bent-knee-dumbbell-calf-raise.n: Bent-Knee Calf Raise (dumbbell on the knee, seated on a bench)
exercise.bent-knee-dumbbell-calf-raise.p: Heels dropped below a step or plate with knees bent: the soleus is at its longest; the gastrocnemius is slack because the knee is bent.
Arms hanging straight down under the chest: rear delts are at their longest; hardest when the arms reach out to the sides.
exercise.bodyweight-squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercise.bodyweight-squat.position: Bottom of a deep squat with hips and knees fully bent: quads and glutes are at their longest (the rectus femoris part of the quads is not, because the hip is bent).
exercise.bulgarian-split-squat.cue.1: Rear foot on a bench or chair
exercise.bulgarian-split-squat.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat (rear foot elevated)
exercise.bulgarian-split-squat.position: Bottom of the lunge: front-leg quads and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.cable-crossover-high.name: High-to-Low Cable Crossover
exercise.cable-crossover-high.position: Arms up and out at the start: lower and middle chest are at their longest.
exercise.cable-crunch.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch (rope, high pulley)
exercise.cable-crunch.position: Torso upright and slightly extended at the top: abs are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.cable-curl.name: Standing Cable Curl (low pulley, in front)
exercise.cable-curl.position: Arms straight by the sides at the bottom: biceps are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.cable-fly-mid.name: Cable Fly (pulleys at chest height, step forward)
exercise.cable-fly-mid.position: Arms open wide and slightly behind the body: chest is at its longest. With pulleys at chest height and a step forward, the cable pulls hardest near this open position.
exercise.cable-front-raise.name: Cable Front Raise (low pulley behind)
exercise.cable-front-raise.position: Arm down by the side or slightly behind the body: front delts are at their longest.
exercise.cable-hip-abduction.name: Standing Cable Hip Abduction (ankle strap)
exercise.cable-hip-abduction.position: Working leg crossed slightly in front of the standing leg: side glutes are at their longest.
exercise.cable-lateral-raise.name: Cable Lateral Raise (low pulley, cable across the front)
exercise.cable-lateral-raise.position: Arm across the front of the body at the bottom: side delts are at their longest; the cable keeps tension in this low position.
exercise.cable-preacher-curl.name: Cable Preacher Curl (pulley low in front of the pad)
exercise.cable-preacher-curl.position: Elbow almost straight on the pad: elbow flexors are at their longest.
exercise.cable-rear-delt-row.name: Cable Rear-Delt Row (rope or bar, pulley at chest height, elbows wide)
exercise.cable-rear-delt-row.position: Arms reaching forward toward the pulley with the shoulder blades spread: rear delts and upper back are at their longest. The cable pulls horizontally, so the load stays fairly even through the pull.
exercise.cable-reverse-fly.name: Cable Reverse Fly (pulleys at shoulder height, cables crossed)
exercise.cable-reverse-fly.position: Arms crossed in front of the chest: rear delts are at their longest.
exercise.chest-dip.name: Chest Dip (torso leaning forward)
exercise.chest-dip.position: Bottom of the dip with shoulders extended: chest and front delts are at their longest.
exercise.chest-supported-dumbbell-revers: Arms hanging down in front of the bench: rear delts are at their longest; hardest when the arms reach out to the sides.
exercise.chest-supported-dumbbell-row.po: Arms hanging straight down in front of the bench: upper back and lats are at their longest.
exercise.chin-up.name: Chin-Up (underhand)
exercise.chin-up.position: Dead hang with arms overhead: lats are at their longest.
exercise.close-grip-bench-press.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercise.close-grip-bench-press.position: Bar at the lower chest with elbows bent: triceps and chest are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.close-grip-lat-pulldown.name: Close Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercise.close-grip-lat-pulldown.positio: Arms fully extended overhead at the top: lats are at their longest.
exercise.conventional-deadlift.name: Barbell Conventional Deadlift
exercise.conventional-deadlift.position: Bar on the floor with hips and knees bent: glutes are at their longest in this movement (hamstrings less so, because the knees are bent).
exercise.deficit-push-up.name: Deficit Push-Up (hands on blocks)
exercise.deficit-push-up.position: Chest below hand level at the bottom: chest is stretched further than in a floor push-up.
exercise.diamond-push-up.name: Diamond (Close-Hand) Push-Up
exercise.diamond-push-up.position: Chest near the hands with elbows bent: triceps are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.dumbbell-bench-press.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercise.dumbbell-bench-press.position: Dumbbells at the bottom beside the chest: chest is at its longest, often a little deeper than with a barbell.
exercise.dumbbell-curl.name: Standing Dumbbell Curl
exercise.dumbbell-curl.position: Arms straight by the sides at the bottom: biceps are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.dumbbell-fly.name: Dumbbell Fly (flat bench)
exercise.dumbbell-fly.position: Arms open wide at the bottom with elbows slightly bent: chest is at its longest.
exercise.dumbbell-front-raise.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercise.dumbbell-front-raise.position: Arm hanging by the thigh at the bottom (front delts only lengthen modestly here); hardest with the arm near shoulder height.
exercise.dumbbell-kickback.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
exercise.dumbbell-kickback.position: Elbow bent with upper arm held back along the torso: triceps are at their longest in this movement; hardest at lockout.
exercise.dumbbell-lateral-raise.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercise.dumbbell-lateral-raise.position: Arm down by the side at the bottom: side delts are at their longest; the dumbbell is hardest when the arm is near shoulder height.
exercise.dumbbell-preacher-curl.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl (seated, pad ~45°)
exercise.dumbbell-preacher-curl.position: Elbow almost straight at the bottom of the pad: elbow flexors are at their longest and the dumbbell is hardest near here.
exercise.dumbbell-pullover.name: Dumbbell Pullover (lying across a bench)
exercise.dumbbell-pullover.position: Arms reaching back behind the head: lats are at their longest, and the dumbbell is hardest here.
exercise.dumbbell-reverse-lunge.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
exercise.dumbbell-reverse-lunge.position: Bottom of the lunge: front-leg quads and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercise.dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.posi: Bottom of the hinge with hips pushed back and knees soft: hamstrings and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.dumbbell-shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercise.dumbbell-shrug.position: Shoulders relaxed and pulled down by the dumbbells: upper traps are at their longest.
exercise.dumbbell-step-up.name: Dumbbell Step-Up (knee-height box)
exercise.dumbbell-step-up.position: Foot on the box with the knee and hip deeply bent at the start: quads and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.dumbbell-walking-lunge.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercise.dumbbell-walking-lunge.position: Bottom of the lunge: front-leg quads and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.dumbbell-wrist-curl.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl (forearm on bench)
exercise.dumbbell-wrist-curl.position: Wrist bent back with the dumbbell rolled toward the fingers: wrist flexors are at their longest.
exercise.ez-bar-curl.name: Standing EZ-Bar Curl
exercise.ez-bar-curl.position: Arms straight by the sides at the bottom: biceps are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.ez-bar-preacher-curl.name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl (pad ~45°)
exercise.ez-bar-preacher-curl.position: Elbows almost straight at the bottom of the pad: elbow flexors are at their longest and the bar is hardest near here.
exercise.ez-bar-skull-crusher.name: Lying EZ-Bar Skull Crusher (bar to forehead)
exercise.ez-bar-skull-crusher.position: Bar lowered toward the forehead with elbows fully bent: triceps are at their longest in this movement; angling the upper arms back toward the head lengthens the long head more.
exercise.face-pull.name: Cable Face Pull (rope, pulley at face height)
exercise.face-pull.position: Arms reaching forward toward the pulley: rear delts and upper back are at their longest. The cable pulls horizontally, so the load stays fairly even through the pull.
exercise.front-squat.name: Barbell Front Squat
exercise.front-squat.position: Bottom of a deep squat with hips and knees fully bent: quads and glutes are at their longest (the rectus femoris part of the quads is not, because the hip is bent).
exercise.goblet-squat.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercise.goblet-squat.position: Bottom of a deep squat with hips and knees fully bent: quads and glutes are at their longest (the rectus femoris part of the quads is not, because the hip is bent).
exercise.gone: This exercise isn't in the library any more. Logged sets still count.
exercise.hack-squat.name: Machine Hack Squat
exercise.hack-squat.position: Bottom of a deep squat with hips and knees fully bent: quads and glutes are at their longest (the rectus femoris part of the quads is not, because the hip is bent).
exercise.hammer-curl.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercise.hammer-curl.position: Arms straight by the sides at the bottom: elbow flexors are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.hanging-knee-raise.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercise.hanging-knee-raise.position: Hanging with legs straight down: abs are at their longest in this movement; the abs work hardest when the pelvis curls up at the top.
exercise.hanging-leg-raise.name: Hanging Straight-Leg Raise
exercise.hanging-leg-raise.position: Hanging with legs straight down: abs are at their longest in this movement; the abs work hardest when the pelvis curls up at the top.
exercise.hip-abduction-machine.name: Seated Hip Abduction Machine
exercise.hip-abduction-machine.position: Knees together at the start: the side glutes (gluteus medius and minimus) are at their longest.
exercise.incline-barbell-bench-press.pos: Bar at the upper chest: chest (especially the upper part) is at its longest.
exercise.incline-dumbbell-bench-press.po: Dumbbells at the bottom beside the upper chest: chest is at its longest.
exercise.incline-dumbbell-curl.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl (bench ~45°, arms hanging behind)
exercise.incline-dumbbell-curl.position: Arms straight and hanging behind the body: biceps are stretched more than in a standing curl because the shoulder is extended.
exercise.incline-dumbbell-fly.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercise.incline-dumbbell-fly.position: Arms open wide at the bottom: chest (especially the upper part) is at its longest.
exercise.inverted-row.name: Inverted Row (bar or rings)
exercise.inverted-row.position: Hanging under the bar with arms straight: upper back and lats are at their longest.
exercise.lat-pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown (wide overhand grip)
exercise.lat-pulldown.position: Arms fully extended overhead at the top: lats are at their longest.
exercise.lean-away-dumbbell-lateral-rais: Arm down and slightly across the body while leaning away from a support: side delts are at their longest, and leaning shifts the hardest point lower than a standard raise.
exercise.leg-extension.name: Leg Extension Machine (seated)
exercise.leg-extension.position: Knees fully bent at the start: quads are at their longest in this movement (sitting with the hip bent keeps the rectus femoris from being fully stretched). On most machines it is hardest near full knee extension.
exercise.leg-press-calf-raise.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercise.leg-press-calf-raise.position: Toes on the platform edge with heels pushed toward you and knees straight: calves are at their longest.
exercise.leg-press.name: 45° Leg Press
exercise.leg-press.position: Sled lowered with knees deeply bent toward the chest: quads and glutes are at their longest.
exercise.lying-dumbbell-triceps-extensio: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension (neutral grip, upper arms vertical)
Dumbbells lowered beside the head with elbows fully bent: triceps are at their longest in this movement; the long head is less stretched than with the arms fully overhead.
exercise.lying-leg-curl.name: Lying (Prone) Leg Curl Machine
exercise.lying-leg-curl.position: Knees straight at the start: hamstrings are at their longest in this movement, but less than in a seated leg curl because the hips are straight. Where it is hardest depends on the machine's cam.
exercise.machine-chest-press.name: Machine Chest Press (seated)
exercise.machine-chest-press.position: Handles at the start position beside the chest: chest is at its longest. Where it is hardest depends on the machine's lever and cam.
exercise.machine-crunch.name: Ab Crunch Machine
exercise.machine-crunch.position: Torso upright at the start: abs are at their longest in this movement. Profile depends on the machine.
exercise.machine-dip.name: Seated Machine Dip
exercise.machine-dip.position: Handles high with elbows deeply bent: triceps are at their longest in this movement. Where it is hardest depends on the machine.
exercise.machine-hip-thrust.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercise.machine-hip-thrust.position: Hips lowered at the bottom: glutes are at their longest in this movement; hardest near full hip extension on most machines.
exercise.machine-lateral-raise.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercise.machine-lateral-raise.position: Arms down by the sides at the start: side delts are at their longest. Profile depends on the machine's cam.
exercise.machine-preacher-curl.name: Machine Preacher Curl
exercise.machine-preacher-curl.position: Elbows almost straight at the start: elbow flexors are at their longest. Profile depends on the machine's cam.
exercise.machine-row.name: Seated Machine Row (chest pad)
exercise.machine-row.position: Arms reaching forward at the start: upper back and lats are at their longest. Where it is hardest depends on the machine.
exercise.machine-shoulder-press.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercise.machine-shoulder-press.position: Handles at shoulder level at the start: front delts are at their longest. Where it is hardest depends on the machine.
exercise.nordic-hamstring-curl.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercise.nordic-hamstring-curl.position: Body lowered toward the floor with knees nearly straight: hamstrings are at their longest and the lever is longest here.
exercise.one-arm-dumbbell-row.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row (hand on bench)
exercise.one-arm-dumbbell-row.position: Arm hanging straight down with the shoulder blade allowed to move forward: lats and upper back are at their longest.
exercise.overhead-cable-triceps-extensio: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension (facing away, rope)
Elbows fully bent with arms overhead: triceps (especially the long head) are at their longest, and the cable is hardest near here.
exercise.overhead-dumbbell-triceps-exten: Hold one dumbbell with both hands
Seated Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension (two hands)
Dumbbell lowered behind the head with arms overhead: triceps (especially the long head) are at their longest.
exercise.pec-deck.name: Pec Deck (machine fly)
exercise.pec-deck.position: Arms open wide at the start: chest is at its longest. Resistance is fairly even across the range on most machines.
exercise.pike-push-up.name: Pike Push-Up
exercise.pike-push-up.position: Head near the floor with hips high: front delts are at their longest.
exercise.plate-loaded-chest-press.name: Plate-Loaded Chest Press
exercise.plate-loaded-chest-press.positi: Handles at the start position beside the chest: chest is at its longest. Where it is hardest depends on the machine's lever arc.
exercise.pull-up.cue.3: Use a band to assist if needed
exercise.pull-up.name: Pull-Up (overhand)
exercise.pull-up.position: Dead hang with arms overhead: lats are at their longest.
exercise.push-up.name: Push-Up
exercise.push-up.position: Chest near the floor: chest is at its longest.
exercise.reverse-cable-curl.name: Reverse-Grip Cable Curl (low pulley)
exercise.reverse-cable-curl.position: Arms straight by the sides: elbow flexors, including the brachioradialis in the forearm, are at their longest.
exercise.reverse-ez-bar-curl.name: Reverse-Grip (Overhand) EZ-Bar Curl
exercise.reverse-ez-bar-curl.position: Arms straight by the sides: elbow flexors, including the brachioradialis in the forearm, are at their longest.
exercise.reverse-hyperextension.name: Reverse Hyperextension Machine
exercise.reverse-hyperextension.position: Legs hanging down with hips bent: glutes and hamstrings are at their longest.
exercise.reverse-nordic.name: Reverse Nordic (kneeling)
exercise.reverse-nordic.position: Leaning back from the kneeling position with hips straight: quads, including the rectus femoris, are at their longest.
exercise.reverse-pec-deck.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercise.reverse-pec-deck.position: Arms forward in front of the chest at the start: rear delts are at their longest.
exercise.rx.intro: Your prescription. Tap a line for the research behind it.
exercise.seated-cable-row.name: Seated Cable Row (close neutral grip)
exercise.seated-cable-row.position: Arms reaching forward with the shoulder blades spread: upper back and lats are at their longest. The cable pulls horizontally, so the load on the back stays fairly even through the pull (unlike free-weight rows, which are hardest at the top).
exercise.seated-calf-raise.name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
exercise.seated-calf-raise.position: Heels dropped below the platform with knees bent: the soleus is at its longest; the gastrocnemius is slack because the knee is bent.
Dumbbells at ear level with elbows below the hands: front delts are at their longest; like the barbell press, it is hardest around the lower-middle part of the press rather than at the very bottom.
exercise.seated-leg-curl.name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
exercise.seated-leg-curl.position: Knees straight with hips bent by the seat: hamstrings are at their longest, more than in a lying leg curl. Where it is hardest depends on the machine's cam.
exercise.single-arm-cable-pulldown.name: Single-Arm Cable Pulldown (kneeling)
exercise.single-arm-cable-pulldown.posit: Arm fully extended overhead and slightly across: lats are at their longest.
Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise (on a step)
Heel dropped below the step with knee straight: calf is at its longest.
exercise.single-leg-hip-thrust.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust (bodyweight)
exercise.single-leg-hip-thrust.position: Hips lowered toward the floor: working-side glute is at its longest in this movement; hardest at the top.
exercise.single-leg-romanian-deadlift.po: Bottom of the hinge: standing-leg hamstring and glute are at their longest.
exercise.sissy-squat.name: Sissy Squat (bodyweight, holding a support)
exercise.sissy-squat.position: Knees far forward and fully bent with hips straight and the torso leaning back: quads, including the rectus femoris, are at their longest.
exercise.slider-leg-curl.name: Slider/Ball Leg Curl (hips up)
exercise.slider-leg-curl.position: Legs straight out with hips lifted: hamstrings are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.smith-machine-bench-press.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercise.smith-machine-bench-press.posit: Bottom of the press, hands or bar near chest level with elbows behind the torso: chest is at its longest.
exercise.smith-machine-calf-raise.name: Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise (on a step)
exercise.smith-machine-calf-raise.positi: Heels dropped below the step with knees straight: calves are at their longest.
exercise.smith-machine-incline-press.pos: Bar at the upper chest: chest is at its longest.
exercise.smith-machine-squat.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercise.smith-machine-squat.position: Bottom of a deep squat with hips and knees fully bent: quads and glutes are at their longest (the rectus femoris part of the quads is not, because the hip is bent).
exercise.standing-calf-raise-machine.pos: Heels dropped below the step with knees straight: calves (gastrocnemius and soleus) are at their longest.
exercise.stiff-leg-deadlift.name: Barbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercise.stiff-leg-deadlift.position: Bottom of the hinge with knees nearly straight: hamstrings are at their longest.
exercise.straight-arm-pulldown.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
exercise.straight-arm-pulldown.position: Arms reaching up toward the high pulley: lats are at their longest.
exercise.t-bar-row.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
exercise.t-bar-row.position: Arms fully extended at the bottom: upper back and lats are at their longest.
exercise.trap-bar-deadlift.name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
exercise.trap-bar-deadlift.position: Handles at the bottom with hips and knees bent: glutes and quads are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.triceps-dip.name: Triceps Dip (upright torso, parallel bars)
exercise.triceps-dip.position: Bottom of the dip with elbows deeply bent: triceps are at their longest in this movement.
exercise.triceps-pushdown.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (rope or bar, high pulley)
exercise.triceps-pushdown.position: Elbows fully bent with upper arms at the sides: triceps are at their longest in this movement (the long head is not fully stretched with the arms down).

settings.convention.blank-rir: A ticked set with a blank RIR is assumed to be at the target RIR, so it counts as a hard set.
settings.convention.bodyweight: For bodyweight sets (blank or 0 kg) the suggestion adds one rep.
settings.convention.easy-trigger: If your last set ended easier than the target RIR, the suggestion adds the weight step before you reach the top of the rep range. This trigger is {app}'s own choice.
settings.convention.load-step: Weight step for the next-session suggestion: +2.5 kg, or +1 kg under 10 kg. The size is {app}'s own choice.
settings.convention.rest-default: Rest timer: {app} starts 2:30 (2–3 min) on every exercise. That is {app}'s default inside the 90 s to 3 min range in the evidence, not a claim that longer rest builds more muscle; use −15 / +15 to change it.
settings.convention.session-note: The summary adds a soft note when one muscle gets more than about 8 hard sets in a session (the upper end of the roughly 3–8 sets per muscle per session guide). It is a note only; nothing is ever blocked.
settings.languageNote: Research text (Why? sheets, research notes) stays in English. Changing language reloads the app.
split.countingNote: Direct sets count 1, helper-muscle sets ½. No fixed weekly target: more hard sets help, each adds a little less.
summary.helperNote: Helper-muscle sets count ½ (lighter bars). Hard = RIR {rir} or less.
summary.noneHard: No sets at RIR {rir} or less in this workout, so nothing counts toward the week.
summary.title: Summary
summary.totalLoad: Total load lifted {kg} kg. Hard sets are the better progress signal.
swap.copyNote: (saved as your own copy of the recommended plan)
swap.loggedStay: Your {sets} of {old} stay in this workout; {new} starts fresh below it.
swap.noAlternatives: No other exercise in the library trains {muscle} as a primary muscle yet.
swap.ranked: Ranked by same muscle ({muscle}), similar movement and where the exercise is hardest.
swap.replaces: {new} replaces {old} with the same number of sets.
swap.restartSuggestions: Load suggestions restart for the new exercise.
swap.title: Replace {name}
swap.updatePlanNote: “Update plan” changes {day} in {plan}{copyNote}. Past workouts stay as logged.
week.countingNote: Direct sets count 1, helper-muscle sets ½. Hard = RIR {rir} or less. There's no fixed weekly target: more hard sets help, each adds a little less.
week.emptyThisBody: Weeks run Monday to Sunday. Every set you tick at RIR {rir} or less counts here, for the muscles it trains.
week.title: Week
you.dataNote: Everything stays in this browser (local storage); nothing is sent anywhere.
you.disclaimer: {app} is a rules-based model, not a coach. It can't see form, sleep or soreness, so treat its suggestions as a starting point.
you.resetBody: Profile, splits, custom exercises, history and any workout in progress will be deleted from this browser.
